WITH scan_data AS (
  SELECT crewref, scancount, gbsize, spanmin
  FROM scans
  WHERE gbsize IS NOT NULL AND spanmin IS NOT NULL AND spanmin > 0
),
operator_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    crewref,
    SUM(scancount) as total_scans,
    AVG(gbsize / spanmin) as avg_gb_per_min
  FROM scan_data
  GROUP BY crewref
),
all_operator_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as overall_avg_gb_per_min
  FROM operator_stats
),
filtered_operators AS (
  SELECT 
    os.crewref,
    os.total_scans,
    os.avg_gb_per_min
  FROM operator_stats os
  CROSS JOIN all_operator_avg aa
  WHERE os.avg_gb_per_min > aa.overall_avg_gb_per_min
)
SELECT 
  AVG(total_scans) as avg_total_scans,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_min) as avg_gb_per_min,
  AVG(avg_gb_per_min) - (SELECT overall_avg_gb_per_min FROM all_operator_avg) as avg_margin_above_overall
FROM filtered_operators;

assumptions.assumption: "Ignore missing values" means filtering out scan records where gbsize or spanmin are NULL, and requiring spanmin > 0 to avoid division by zero
The "simple average of that figure across all operators" is an unweighted arithmetic mean—each operator weighted equally regardless of scan count
